format: patches[]: op in replace_params | add_rule | add_quest. replace_params/add_rule target an existing quest (and for replace_params an existing rule kind); add_quest creates a quest entry. Only the 16 existing kinds are used; new kinds / params / reductions are in proposed[].

patches.why: existing cells=["GSDocMitchellHouse"] is the interior the player LEAVES to start the DLC (quest script line "Player.GetInCell GSDocMitchellHouse == 0"); a tether on that cell defers every stage request of the quest (10, 20, 30, 100) until all players are inside the house, so the DLC could never start (stage 10 is requested only once the player is OUTSIDE). The caravan is in the open Mojave, so there is no cell name to list: use an empty cell list (no spatial gate) and gather=wait until L4 supports a ref anchor (proposed param anchor_ref=NVDLC02JedREF).
the departure also does Player.MoveTo NVDLC02SlideShowMarkerREF in the intro slideshow; only NPC markers besides StartMarker were listed
the player moves are done by NVDLC02MQ05Timer (NVDLC02MQ05PlayerMarkerREF) and NVDLC02MQ05Timer2 (NVDLC02MQ05ClimaxMarkerREF), not by the MQ05 stage scripts the markers came from

cells stay empty: Zion Valley is exterior worldspace NVDLC02ZionCanyon (no per-area cell name). Empty list = no spatial gate, so the "party in the same area" rule needs an L4 worldspace/anchor param (see proposed[] in rules.patch.json). Documented so nobody assumes the tether works
MQ01 quest script reads GetDistance from the victim ref and the ambush code reads IsKiller; GetInCell is used by the arrival box

stage 10 adds a unique reward to the shared locker only if Player.GetItemCount == 0; min-over-party is 0 as soon as ANY player lacks the item, so every player can get a copy (any-party-member returns 1.0/0.0 only, see rules.cpp reduceCondition)

proposed.why: MQ03a needs 2 totems (GetItemCount NVDLC02WhiteLegTotem >= 2), MS01 needs 3 roots, MQ02c needs 5 lunchboxes, MQ02b needs 2 walkie-talkies. Loot is picked up through containers (not AddItem effects), so in a party the pieces are spread across players. any-party-member returns only 1.0/0.0 (rules.cpp reduceCondition) and could never reach the count; a pooled count (sum over the party) makes the quest advance the way it does for one player.

The Jed departure gate compares GetActorValue InventoryWeight with 76 / 101. Reductions today are initiator, any-party-member (returns 1.0 or 0.0, so a later >= 76 compare fails), min-over-party and entry/exit; none returns the largest numeric value. A numeric max-over-party makes the INFO refuse while ANY player is overweight.

params.topics: list of INFO refs that fork the story

proposed.why: Daniel INFOs 010718/010723 (Joshua path, StartQuest NVDLC02MQ04) vs 0093AA (Daniel path, StartQuest NVDLC02MQ05) fork the DLC irreversibly and fail the side quests; initiator-picks lets one player decide for everyone. A consent step (default party-vote, tie goes to the host) fits the "party = one Courier" principle without a new owner decision.

Zion Valley, the caravan and the Narrows are open worldspace (NVDLC02ZionCanyon) or Mojave exterior: there is no cell name for PartyTether.cells. A ref anchor + radius (NVDLC02JedREF, NVDLC02DanielREF, NVDLC02JoshuaREF) lets the tether work outdoors.

params.action: ignore OnStartCombat from party members unless the host confirms

proposed.why: Joshua and Daniel scripts start MQ06 (fail the whole DLC) on OnStartCombat Player; any one player (or a stray grenade) can end the DLC for everybody. Needs a confirm / ignore policy; not expressible with the existing kinds.
